findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed run's gate log records its command with a literal `<venv>` placeholder in place of the interpreter path, so the header names a command that was never run and a reader cannot reproduce the arm from the log.

follow-on: _worktree_unchanged_since_base returns True (vacuous) when the worktree is gone and reads only `git diff --name-only HEAD`, so neither untracked deliverables nor a reclaimed worktree are seen; an armed run that declared no changed path but left untracked files, or whose worktree was reclaimed, is exempted without a full worktree proof.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit ba7c0c7 against base 7132e05; 99 added lines in promotion.py (_manifest_declares_no_change, _worktree_unchanged_since_base, _run_changed_nothing, and the unchanged branch in _evaluate_suite_delta), one line in ledger.py, 224 lines of new test, one line in tests/test_ledger.py, and a 59-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names the unchanged exemption plus the two refusals (head moved past base; empty manifest contradicted by a moved worktree) as tests; all three pass at ba7c0c7 and the exemption case reddens without the guard (negative control EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: promotion._evaluate_suite_delta now returns a suite_delta of status "unchanged" for an armed run whose fresh manifest declares no changed path and no commit beyond the base over a worktree still sitting on that base, so an unchanged run promotes without a baseline/after suite pair; tests/test_an_unchanged_run_needs_no_suite_pair.py drives the exemption and the two refusals, all green at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; status complete, commit ba7c0c74 named, three logs named, the negative-control path and its declared string recorded, and both arm logs on disk; the manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, so this review ran the two arms itself and derived the added-failure pair through the store's own reader.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff touches five paths; four are inside the declared fence (reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/ledger.py, the new test file, the evidence fragment) and tests/test_ledger.py is outside it, disclosed in the manifest's follow_ons as a one-line tally assertion the required ledger key change broke.

justifications.durability: the exemption and both refusals are driven by tests that redden without the guard (negative control), and the tests build a real git repository and read the worktree rather than comparing a value against the input the test passed in; held back because the worktree-gone and untracked-file edges are neither tested nor named.
justifications.evidence: the run records a gate (3 passed), a second focused gate (1 passed), and a negative control whose first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim and whose last line is EXIT=1 with the expected missing-suite refusal; docked because the gate log's own command line carries a literal `<venv>` placeholder rather than the interpreter path, so the recorded command is not the literal command that ran, and because the run names no baseline_suite/after_suite pair so its added-failure count is unmeasured from its own record (this review supplied the pair).
justifications.fit: the three helpers follow the module's existing read-then-verify style with mechanism docstrings, the commit body states the why without plan or ticket identifiers or attribution, and the ledger tally gains the new key beside its siblings.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal is met at the changed revision: an armed run whose manifest declares no change over a worktree still on its base returns suite_delta status unchanged with the suite_command and an empty added_failure_ids, and both refusal paths still refuse with missing baseline_suite, after_suite; held back one point because the worktree half is vacuous when the worktree is gone, so the exemption can be granted on the manifest claim alone.
justifications.scope_discipline: four of the five changed paths are inside the declared fence and the fifth (tests/test_ledger.py) is a one-line tally assertion the required ledger key change broke; it is outside the fence but is disclosed in the manifest and touches no concurrent node, so the discipline is good but not perfect.
